result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including a marked crosswalk and sidewalks. However, the environment is characterized by a wide crossing distance, degraded pavement, and a large vehicle obstructing sightlines at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large red minivan is positioned in the intersection, blocking the sightline between pedestrians at the curb and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily cracked and patched, which can create uneven surfaces for pedestrians and cyclists.

hazards.name: Faded Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk and lane markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals, despite being controlled by a traffic light. The roadway pavement is significantly degraded with visible cracking and faded markings, increasing risks for all road users.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The road surface is heavily cracked and worn, which can cause tripping hazards or difficulty for those using mobility aids.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and improve the walking/rolling surface for all users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide sidewalk with a curb ramp and tactile warnings, but is compromised by a large brick building that creates a blind corner. While traffic signals and 'No Turn on Red' signs are present, there are no visible marked crosswalks at the immediate intersection.

hazards.name: Blind Corner
hazards.description: The brick building is situated close to the curb, obstructing sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, where the building meets the sidewalk corner.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: Despite the presence of a curb ramp, there are no visible painted crosswalk markings to delineate the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility of the pedestrian crossing area.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, a marked zebra crosswalk, and traffic signals. While mature trees provide a pleasant environment, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main street

hazards.name: Potential sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street may partially obscure pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, mid-ground

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.
